title: Majority Element
statement:
Given an array of N integers, find the majority element.

The majority element is the element that appears more than N/2 times. It is guaranteed that a majority element always exists.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the majority element.

examples.explanation: 3 appears 2 times out of 3, which is more than 3/2 = 1.5.
2 appears 4 times out of 7, which is more than 3.5.
